payload.summary: Implemented phase 1 review-dispatch robustness: schema-derived prompts, coerce-then-validate, one repair retry, per-vendor timeout budget through converge(), judgment ingest, raw stdout sidecars, and fast-empty rejection. Local-parallel in the feature worktree because this harness has no coordinator lock MCP.

decisions.title: Runtime JSON sidecars next to the helper
decisions.rationale: Load coercion and timeout tables from files beside review_findings_schema.py so they survive change archival.

decisions.title: Repair is a second dispatch with the same timeout
decisions.rationale: Exactly one constrained rewrite; AUTH/UNAVAILABLE/CAPACITY skip repair.
